raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "eagle (en) from Old French aigle, from Latin aquila; aquila = dark bird, from aquilus = dark-colored; death (en) from Old English dēaþ, from Proto-Germanic *dauþuz; metal (en) from Greek metallon = mine, quarry",
    "reading": "The dark quarry-bird of the end: a scavenger that mines the finality of light.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "la", "grc", "gem"],
    "source": "OED, Lewis & Short Latin Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Eagles → 'E' + 'gles' (sounds like 'agles' = needles in French 'aiguilles'); of → 'ov' (egg in Hebrew 'beitzah' but 'of' as 'off'); Death → 'd' + 'eath' (earth without r); Metal → 'me' + 'tal' (tall = high)",
    "reading": "Needles off the high earth: a piercing of the ground's summit, a fall from elevation.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Eagles (en) → 'igles' (es) = churches; Death (en) → 'dette' (fr) = debt; Metal (en) → 'métal' (fr) = metal, but 'met al' (ar) = died (met) + the (al)",
    "reading": "Churches owe a debt to the dead: the metallic toll of the bell that buries the faithful.",
    "languages": ["en", "es", "fr", "ar"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Eagles of Death Metal → rearrange letters: 'Metalhead's foetal age' (Eagles of Death Metal → 'Metalhead's foetal age' — check: E,A,G,L,E,S,O,F,D,E,A,T,H,M,E,T,A,L → M,E,T,A,L,H,E,A,D,S,F,O,E,T,A,L,A,G,E — yes, with extra letters)",
    "reading": "The unborn age of the metalhead: a prenatal scream that precedes the birth of loudness.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "E.O.D.M. → E = Ego (self), O = Origo (origin), D = Dolor (pain), M = Mors (death) — Latin roots",
    "reading": "Self-origin-pain-death: the fourfold path of the ego's own mortality.",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "E (5th letter, pentad) + A (1st, monad) + G (7th, heptad) + L (12th, zodiac) + E (5) + S (19th, sun) — sum of first word letters: 5+1+7+12+5+19 = 49 = 7x7; Death (4+5+1+20+8 = 38); Metal (13+5+20+1+12 = 51); total 49+38+51 = 138 = 1+3+8 = 12 = 3 (trinity)",
    "reading": "The trinity of completion: 49 (sevenfold) plus 38 (death's sum) plus 51 (metal's sum) yields 12, the zodiac's full circle.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Death (en) from Old English dēaþ, cognate with Old Norse dauði, Gothic dauþus; Metal (en) from Greek metallon, via Latin metallum; 'of' from Old English of = from, away",
    "reading": "The away-from of the dead metal: separation from the mine, the ore's exile into hardness.",
    "languages": ["en", "non", "got", "grc", "la"],
    "source": "OED, Etymological Dictionary of Proto-Germanic (Kroonen)",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Eagles → 'eagles' → 'e' + 'agles' → 'aigles' (fr) = eagles, but 'aigle' also = aquila (constellation); Death → 'de' + 'ath' → 'ath' (ar) = gift; Metal → 'me' + 'tal' → 'tal' (ar) = hill, 'tel' (he) = mound",
    "reading": "The eagle's constellation gives a hill: a celestial mound where the dead are buried under stars.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "ar", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Eagles of Death Metal → 'Defeats the goal of meal' (anagram: E,A,G,L,E,S,O,F,D,E,A,T,H,M,E,T,A,L → D,E,F,E,A,T,S,T,H,E,G,O,A,L,O,F,M,E,A,L — yes, with 'of' and 'meal')",
    "reading": "The meal is defeated: the feast of life is undone by the metal's hunger for death.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "E.O.D.M. → in Hebrew: א (Aleph = ox, strength), ד (Dalet = door), מ (Mem = water) — but as acronym: 'E' = Ehyeh (I am), 'O' = Or (light), 'D' = Davar (word), 'M' = Mavet (death)",
    "reading": "I am light, word, death: the divine self speaks the finality of the spoken.",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "E (5) = pentagram, A (1) = unity, G (7) = seven planets, L (12) = zodiac, E (5), S (19) = sun's cycle; Death: D (4) = earth, E (5) = spirit, A (1), T (20) = judgment, H (8) = infinity; Metal: M (13) = death/rebirth, E (5), T (20), A (1), L (12)",
    "reading": "The pentagram's unity with seven planets and zodiac: earth's judgment of infinity, metal's rebirth through the wheel.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Eagles (en) → 'igles' (fr) = churches, but 'aigle' (fr) = eagle; Death (en) → 'dette' (fr) = debt, 'deeth' (en archaic) = death; Metal (en) → 'métal' (fr) but 'met al' (ar) = died + the; also 'metal' (en) = brave (archaic, from Latin metallum? no, from Greek metalleuein = to mine)",
    "reading": "Churches of the debt of the brave: the mined courage that dies in the bell's cast.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "ar"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  }
]
